announcements.headline: Clarification Re: Admission of Ordinary Shares
announcements.insight: Capai PLC clarifies the admission of ordinary shares following the August fundraise. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for settlement details.

announcements.headline: Fundraise
announcements.insight: Capai PLC raises funds following its interim results and recent licence extensions. Shareholders should monitor dilution effects from this capital raise.

announcements.headline: Licence and Option Agreement for Ageotype
announcements.insight: Capai PLC has entered a new licence and option agreement for Ageotype. This follows earlier extensions of similar agreements in July 2026.

announcements.headline: Extension of Licence and Option Agreements
announcements.insight: Capai PLC extends licence and option agreements following its interim results. This suggests ongoing operational continuity for the capMedia platform.

announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim Results are released following the capMedia Platform Portfolio Update in June. Shareholders should monitor for financial performance details linked to the platform.

announcements.headline: capAI Chairman Professor Ronjon Nag Awarded OBE
announcements.insight: The Chairman received an OBE. This follows the June platform update, suggesting continued leadership stability for capAI.

announcements.headline: capMedia Platform Portfolio Update and Webinar
announcements.insight: Capai PLC provides a portfolio update for its capMedia Platform. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on performance or strategic actions.
